title: Random seeds produce fresh results
summary:
Random-seed requests got their randomness back, while mobile tables and the API docs became easier to use.

Three PRs fixed `seed=-1` across text and image generation: requests bypass gateway caches, and the services turn -1 into a fresh seed instead of producing repeat results. An explicit image `seed=0` also stays intact.

API key and Pricing tables now scroll inside their own containers on narrow screens, rather than pushing the whole page sideways.

The README, quick references, app template and service docs now direct developers to `gen.pollinations.ai`. The regenerated API reference adds a vision example and clarifies the `/v1/models` response format and model-restricted keys.
